headline: MCA draft proposes CSR agency registration cancellation and three-year bar: report
summary_points: The CSR Universe reports an MCA draft under which CSR implementing agencies may face cancellation of registration.
The draft reportedly also proposes a three-year bar on agencies found in default.
Full text, trigger conditions and applicability are not available; details are unconfirmed.
The proposal is reported as a draft and is not yet final; the effective date is not known.
who_is_affected: CSR implementing agencies registered with MCA (Form CSR-1), and companies that route CSR funds through them.
action_required: Read the official MCA draft when published, review agency compliance and due diligence, and consider submitting comments within the consultation window.

MCA draft on CSR implementing agencies: what is reported

According to The CSR Universe, a draft from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs proposes that CSR implementing agencies could face cancellation of their registration and a three-year bar.

What we know so far:
- The proposal is reported as a draft, not a final rule.
- It reportedly covers cancellation of registration and a three-year bar for agencies.
- Trigger conditions, procedure and the effective date have not been confirmed in the material available.

Why it matters:
Companies relying on implementing agencies for CSR spend may need to strengthen due diligence and monitoring. Agencies should review their compliance, reporting and utilisation records.

We will update this post once the official text is reviewed.

Please verify the details with the official MCA source before acting.
